name: exodus-backend
description: Amplify Gen 2 backend for EXODUS Couples-in-Sync (auth, data, server-side counseling).

scripts.sandbox:once: AWS_PROFILE=${AWS_PROFILE:-babysos} AWS_REGION=${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1} ampx sandbox --once && npm run sync:outputs
scripts.sync:outputs: AWS_PROFILE=${AWS_PROFILE:-babysos} AWS_REGION=${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1} ampx generate outputs --format dart --out-dir lib
